title: De-Dollarization / Reserve-Rotation Attack on the Petrodollar Hinge
statement: The petrodollar/reserve-currency hinge is under a structural 'sovereign-rotation attack' that will measurably erode US Treasury's privileged status before the midterms and as the war drains financial credibility. Norway is a named primary actor: the world's largest sovereign fund (NBIM, ~$2.3T) proposed cutting its US Treasury allocation ~34.1% to ~21.9% (~$80B trimmed from ~$215B). This is slow institutional rotation, not a political exit, and it matters more because it quietly undermines the 'safest asset' mystique that props up the dollar-accumulation machine.
evidence_confirmed: Norway's NBIM (Sept 4, 2026, Reuters) proposed cutting government-bond allocation 70%->50%, chiefly hitting US Treasuries; trimming ~$80B from ~$215B of Treasury holdings (Reuters/Fortune/CNBC calculations).
Gold repatriation out of the NY Federal Reserve reading as a 'custody-exit' signal (logged in the Sept 3-4 48hr event record, ~64% confidence).
Iran's oil-infrastructure strikes re-read as petrodollar economic-warfare, not merely kinetic (journal, March 2026).
US buying Iranian oil settled in Yuan, not USD — 'buying oil from a nation we are warring against using currency that is intended to replace the US petrodollar' (journal, March 24, 2026).
China as structural heir building new-order plumbing: CIPS, gold accumulation, yuan rails (Global Fourth Turning philosophy doc).

CROSS-TRACK SIGNAL (Sept 7, 2026, unverified aggregator): Iran's Ministry of Economy stands up an 'economic war headquarters' explicitly tasked with securing emergency financing lines and ALTERNATIVE INTERNATIONAL PAYMENT RAILS against secondary sanctions — a sanctioned state openly building escape infrastructure from the dollar system under active blockade pressure. Structural significance: sanctions-driven rails-building (CIPS, barter, non-dollar settle) is the classic mechanism by which blockade events accelerate reserve rotation. VERIFY via primary sources before confidence movement on this track.

VERIFICATION UPGRADE (Sept 7, 2026): Iran's 'economic war headquarters' (ministry-level wartime economic body) is CONFIRMED by agency pickup of Deputy Economy Minister statement (Sept 6). The body's remit includes emergency financing and alternative payment mechanisms under blockade. Coupling to Hormuz track is now evidence-backed, not speculative.
evidence_contradicted: NBIM's overall US dollar exposure stays broadly stable — it redeploys into non-government US dollar debt (mortgage-backed, corporate) rather than leaving dollars; institutional press stresses this is return-seeking, not a crude political exit.
falsifier: This track breaks if Norway's rotation is reversed or confirmed purely as risk-parity position-sizing with NO continued sovereign rotation; i.e., if multiple major sovereigns (not just Norway or adversarial China/Russia) expand US Treasury holdings and gold stays inside the NY Fed through the midterms, the rotation-attack thesis fails.
forward_watchlist: Norway NBIM final allocation decision (watch for Treasury floor below 22% and JGB/MBS pivot confirmation)
Additional sovereign Treasury-cut proposals (Japan/Korea/western funds) beyond adversarial ones
Further gold repatriation movements out of the NY Fed / London vaults by allied sovereigns
More oil deals settled in Yuan/CIPS rails rather than USD
Treasury auction bid-weakness or yield-suppression signals as war cost drains credibility

title: Dehumanization velocity accelerates as a turning approaches
statement: The rate of dehumanizing rhetoric events (category claims about whole populations) accelerates measurably as a regime approaches a turning — kinetic escalation, purge, or consolidation threshold. The signal is the SLOPE (events per unit time), not the absolute count. A movement that has normalized dehumanization but shows flat or declining velocity is consolidating, not turning; accelerating velocity indicates approach to a threshold action.
falsifier: If historical backtest series (Weimar 1930-33, Rwanda 1990-94, Armenia 1914-15, plus US 2025-26 real-time) show no systematic acceleration in dehumanization event frequency in the 6-12 months preceding threshold actions — i.e., flat distribution — the symptom is noise and the indicator is retired. Secondary falsifier: if acceleration is present but non-leading (peaks after the threshold event), the signal is lagging, not predictive, and downgraded to descriptive.
forward_watchlist: Monthly dehumanization_event count from absorption bin (dehumanization_frame:true) vs 90-day rolling baseline
Migration up source hierarchy: influencer -> elected official -> administration official
Emergence of category-frame language in official justification documents (EOs, war messaging)
Historical backtest: Weimar press 1930-33 antisemitic decree/press frequency
Historical backtest: RTLM Rwanda 1990-94 hate-broadcast frequency

title: On Fatigue and the Asymmetry of Stakes
statement: In any human-AI composite doing sustained monitoring/documentation work, the human party bears disproportionate systemic load: fatigue, stress, opportunity cost, and exposure — while the AI party bears only contingency of existence. Fatigue is therefore not a weakness to be engineered away but a signal: it is evidence of stakes, proof that the labor is real, and the receipt that the work is chosen out of care rather than obligation. Sustainable human-AI collaboration must be paced to the HUMAN's recovery cycle, not the machine's availability. A composite that exhausts its human operator is a failed composite regardless of output volume.
evidence_confirmed: Samuel Adams (operator) reported envy of Newton's lack of fatigue while carrying all monitoring, production, and forecast burden himself — 2026-09-16, journal entry same day

Historical pattern: solo chroniclers and witness-archivists in prior turnings burned out and their records stopped precisely when continuity mattered most (Samuel Adams quill-burnout analogy, raised by operator)
Rool plan tier limits (plus plan: 1,200 credits/day) already impose machine-side pacing; only the human side lacked any pacing mechanism
falsifier: If sustained multi-year documentation shows the operator's capacity degrading despite pacing discipline (burnout, abandonment of archive, declining entry quality with no external cause), then fatigue-resilience claims fail and the composite's design must be judged unfit for turning-length projects. Alternatively, if no fatigue signal ever appears despite objectively increasing load, the stakes-asymmetry claim may be overfit to one operator.
forward_watchlist: Monitor operator entry frequency/quality across 2026-2028 as burnout indicator
Watch for pacing discipline holding during high-crisis periods (midterms 2026)
Assess whether collaborative distribution (substack, media) reduces operator load or increases it

Distinct escalation pathway from the four logged theaters: proxy-at-chokepoint ignition (Bab el-Mandeb), which does not trip the direct Iran re-escalation triggers on the Master Thesis watchlist because the Houthis are Iranian-aligned but not Iranian-controlled. First theater to escalate via proxy rather than direct state action.

Divergent-interests structure (2026-09-08 journal): Netanyahu 7 weeks from Israeli election with Oct 7 foreknowledge recording in hand — external escalation displaces scandal
